description_en: Returns all your certification authority (CA) certificates. These include certificates generated by Private CA and imported external certificates
description_zh: 返回用户所有CaCertificate，包括PCA内部产生的与导入的外部证书
name: DescribePcaAndExternalCACertificateList

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. The default value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页显示多少条记录。默认值为50
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en: One or more certificate identifiers, separated by commas
parameters.help_zh: 证书标识。多个标识间英文逗号间隔
parameters.name: identifiers

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search on the name, domain name, and SAN fields
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字。支持通过名称、域名、SANS模糊查询
parameters.name: key_word
